lines.text: Jesus warns against doing righteous acts to be seen, and says hypocrites sound a trumpet when giving to the needy.
Jesus says hypocrites pray in the temple courts, but you should go into your inner room and shut your door.

wrong_details.true: the synagogues and on street corners

lines.text: Jesus says when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face, so your fasting is not obvious to men.
